continueHint: Keep completed changes and check execution records before continuing.
continuePrompt: Inspect the current project, scene and existing execution receipts first. Keep completed changes and continue only unfinished parts of the previous task. Check uncertain outcomes before acting. Do not recreate existing content or resubmit accepted or uncertain generation jobs.
